prose: Jacob Diaz, aka the Undercover Virologist, joins InnerVerse to bring us up to date on his last five years of research into the truth about germs, bacteria and so-called viruses. Tune in for valuable information that uncomplicates disease, demolishes mainstream germ theory, teaches the purpose and pleomorphic powers of our biome, and brings the cold hard truth to light about what antibiotics do to a body.
ext: We discuss HIV/AIDS, how pleomorphism reacts to mental/emotional shifts, the energetic principles of our blood, a show & tell of holographic blood images, the magical memory capacity of water, parasites and their role in the terrain, and comprehending cancers as a last-ditch healing response.
